entities.summary: Kisekae Set System is a file format used to create and display digital dress-up paper dolls. The original KiSS format was intended for simple virtual dress-up games in which the user could drag clothing onto a doll figure. Over time, various extensions to the KiSS standard were introduced, adding animation capabilities and a wider range of interactive features.
